fusions.name: Gentle Nudge
fusions.desc: Leans your whole weight into the target, dealing 12 damage, knocking it back 2 tiles and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It is [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Tide Slap
fusions.desc: Slaps a tail along the water at a target up to 5 tiles away, dealing 7 damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Calm Pulse
fusions.desc: A slow pulse from under your plates restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Slow Tide
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 15, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second permanently.
